description.value:
Show me the books. I will find the clause.

Mode: Extraction and termination / drift: Sideways

Level 1: The Examination

When you observe an ongoing agreement, contract, magical pact, or institutional arrangement for at least 1 minute of scene time (one round in combat), you may make a Soul (Investigation (Mind)) check DC 17. On success, the GM reveals one clause, condition, or structural weakness the agreement's parties don't know about or have forgotten. You may spend 2 Surge to invoke that clause in the current scene, compelling the obligated party to honor it.

Level 5: Pressure Point

When you invoke a clause via The Examination, you may add an enforcement rider: the target creature or faction takes Tier d6 psychic damage (to Stress) — or, against a faction, 1 OP from the relevant bank if they attempt to break the clause rather than honor it. The rider is invisible until tested. Savvy targets may detect it on a Soul check DC 17.

Level 9: Formal Correction

Once per scene, you may declare an agreement, ruling, or magical binding to be in violation of its own terms. If the GM agrees the violation is factually supportable, the agreement enters a state of formal correction: its effects are suspended for one scene, or until formally resolved — whichever ends first, and the obligated parties must negotiate a correction or accept termination.

Level 13: Termination Of Standing

You may formally terminate a contract, institution, or ongoing magical binding that has become structurally broken. The process takes 10 minutes of uninterrupted action and 10 Surge. The target ends: contracts become void, institutions dissolve their formal authority, magical bindings unbind. This is a capital-T Termination and is recognized as legitimate by the setting's political and metaphysical systems. Informal agreements are immune; only structured bindings can be Terminated. Once per session.

Level 17: The Final Audit (Capstone)

Once per campaign, you may declare a Final Audit against a major faction, institution, or long-standing political arrangement. Over the course of one full session of investigation and procedural action, you examine every ongoing obligation, clause, and structural dependency of the target. At session end, you either (a) declare the target structurally sound and grant it +2 stability for the rest of the session, or (b) identify 3 enforceable structural failures that may be prosecuted individually or collectively. If collective, the target is subject to formal dissolution proceedings.

Recosted 2026-08-23: this ability's earlier economy (Civic Charge / Strain / Resonance / Leverage / Administrative Pressure) is retired — everything now runs on Surge, Clarity, Noise, and the misfire ladder. The ability dialog's cost line is the truth; ledgers named here are narrative, GM-adjudicated, never a tracked pool.

Balance pass 2026-08-23: all costs and durations finalized against the live Surge economy and DC ladder.
